dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a moderately concave curvature with a smooth spline transition from the apex to the posterior dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a small pixel radius, creating a sharp termination point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow convex arc with a large radius relative to the head size, sloping gradually toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby beak with a low length-to-thickness ratio, protruding distinctly from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clear obtuse inflection point of approximately 150 degrees where the melon contour meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular, high-luminance light-cyan macule or patch located on the dorsal surface anterior to the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Overall low-polygon geometric rendering style with non-naturalistic uniform surface luminance and sharpened perimeter aliasing.
